name: Autonomous agriculture and precision farming
summary: Sensors, computer vision and automated machines apply inputs or perform field work with finer control.
useCase: A sprayer identifies weeds and treats selected patches, while a farmer monitors performance and exceptions.
whyNow: John Deere reports a rapid increase in acres treated with its selective-spraying system. This validates a concrete input-saving application, while full farm autonomy remains a broader and harder problem.

mainstream.scope: Routine precision spraying, automated guidance and selected supervised autonomous tasks on commercially suitable farms.
mainstream.rationale: Savings in chemicals, labour and time can create a measurable purchase case. Crops, field geometry and capital access differ, so the forecast concerns selected farm operations rather than fully unattended farms everywhere.

metric.name: Acres treated using John Deere See & Spray
metric.scope: Company-reported selective-spraying coverage; 2025 scope includes US and Canada
metric.limitations: One product-family deployment proxy, not total precision agriculture or fully autonomous acres. Published geographic scope expands between observations and treated acres need not be unique farm acres; the fivefold comparison is approximate.
metric.futureNote: No defensible like-for-like external forecast is available for this KPI. The forward maturity path is a separately labelled analyst scenario, not a numerical adoption forecast.

tailwinds: Selective spraying can reduce purchased inputs
Labour constraints favour assistance on repetitive tasks
Retrofits can extend existing equipment instead of requiring a new fleet
bottlenecks: Upfront machine cost and seasonal utilisation
Vision performance varies by crop, weather and field condition
Service availability, connectivity and equipment compatibility
watchMetrics: Paid acres operated and recurring software utilisation
Input savings measured against comparable fields and yield
Payback period, downtime and human interventions per operating hour
